Question Choices: Evaluate lim x->1 of 4x^3 - x by direct substitution.
Solution: At a point of continuity, the limit equals the function value, so direct substitution is valid. Polynomials, sine, cosine and absolute value are continuous on the reals; square root is continuous on its real domain; a rational function is continuous wherever its original denominator is nonzero. Trigonometric angles here are in radians. lim x->1 of 4*x**3 - x = 3
